admin.loyalty.guide.bannerTitle: New to rewards? Read the setup guide
admin.loyalty.guide.bannerText: Every field explained with examples, a full customer story using your settings, and recommended values.
admin.loyalty.guide.title: Rewards setup guide
admin.loyalty.guide.subtitle: What each setting means, with examples
admin.loyalty.guide.whatText: Points are like store coins. Customers collect them when they shop and later use them as a discount at checkout. You decide how many coins they get and what each coin is worth.
admin.loyalty.guide.valueText: Sets how much discount one point gives. Start here — every other amount on the page is worked out from this.
admin.loyalty.guide.valueExample: 100 points = Rs 10 means 1 point is worth Rs 0.10. A customer with 500 points can get Rs 50 off.
admin.loyalty.guide.earnText: How many points a customer gets for shopping. Write the points in the first box and the amount spent in the second.
admin.loyalty.guide.earnExample: 20 points for every Rs 100 → a Rs 1,000 order earns 200 points. With 100 points = Rs 10, that is Rs 20 back (2%).
admin.loyalty.guide.yourEarn: Your setting: {points} points for every {spend} → customers get back {pct}% of what they spend.
admin.loyalty.guide.minOrderText: Orders smaller than this get no points. Leave 0 so every order earns.
admin.loyalty.guide.minOrderExample: Minimum Rs 500 → a Rs 400 order earns nothing, a Rs 600 order earns normally.
admin.loyalty.guide.bonusText: Free points a new customer gets after creating and verifying an account. A great reason to sign up.
admin.loyalty.guide.bonusExample: Bonus 100 points with 100 points = Rs 10 → every new customer starts with Rs 10 to spend.
admin.loyalty.guide.minPointsText: A customer can only use points after collecting at least this many. This stops very tiny discounts.
admin.loyalty.guide.minPointsExample: Minimum 100 → a customer with 80 points keeps collecting; at 100 points they can use them.
admin.loyalty.guide.maxText: The most of an order that points can pay. The rest is paid normally (cash, card, COD).
admin.loyalty.guide.maxExample: 50% on a Rs 2,000 order → points can pay at most Rs 1,000; the customer pays the other Rs 1,000.

admin.loyalty.guide.faqQ1: When does the customer get the points?
admin.loyalty.guide.faqA1: When the order is placed the points show as pending. They become usable once the order is marked Delivered.
admin.loyalty.guide.faqQ2: What if an order is cancelled?
admin.loyalty.guide.faqA2: Points earned on it are taken back, and any points the customer spent on it are returned. A balance never goes below zero.
admin.loyalty.guide.faqQ3: Do points count shipping and tax?
admin.loyalty.guide.faqA3: No. Points are earned on the items total only.
admin.loyalty.guide.faqQ4: Can I give or remove points myself?
admin.loyalty.guide.faqA4: Yes. Open the Members tab, choose a customer and use Adjust points. Add a short reason — it shows in their history.
